title: Pending publish operations UI overhaul
summary: Reworked the Pending Publish default WebView surface into an operations band with failed/drained/ready/review counters, a focused file inventory, selected-row detail, and drain progress while preserving backend-owned drain authority.
reason: The previous tab buried the actionable drain surface among many diagnostic panels, making it harder to see current parked rows, blockers, failures, and recent drain evidence at a glance.
behavior_before: Pending Publish opened with separate metrics, action center, pending item summary, drain controls, rows, and selected details spread across the page. Failed and drained evidence were not first-screen triage counters, and the primary table emphasized raw state/age columns.
behavior_after: Pending Publish opens on a compact operations band with concrete next action, display-only triage filters, a seven-column file inventory, selected item detail, and drain progress. Advanced diagnostics, recovery, repair, and evidence boards remain available behind Advanced without changing backend drain scope.
